name: week
title: Dock operations review
subtitle: Recorded appointments only. Local times show the named site timezone.

sections.title: Dock plan
sections.sql: select code,site,dock,carrier,local_start,timezone,status from v_appointments where status in ('requested','scheduled','arrived','in_progress') order by starts_at

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select code,site,reason,detail from v_attention order by reason,code

sections.title: Carrier review
sections.sql: select * from v_carrier_scorecard order by carrier
sections.note: Lateness threshold is the demo operating policy of 15 minutes. Missing observations are not on-time arrivals.

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select code,rule,finding from v_compliance order by rule,code
